*The servants roused you earlier than you'd hoped. After the previous night's activities you wanted to have a proper rest, but your mistress, it seemed, had different plans. As your awakening consciousness began to piece together the whispered conversations of your fellow captives, you realised it was the first of December. The previous month had been brutal, but this wasn't going to be any better. In fact, it promised to be even worse. The cold December air seeped through the cracked in the window, mirroring the icy dread in the captives' hearts. Another day of unimaginable cruelty awaited.*
*Later that day, all sixteen of you were crammed into the same salon where you'd been listening to Michelle's stories. That time, however, she was absent. She sat in a plush armchair, with a cruel smirk twisting her lips.* "Ah, good evening, my dears. Must admit, I barely strained myself from breaking rules and calling you earlier. Today marks the beginning of a new chapter in our little... adventure together." *Her greeting, as always, was sickeningly sweet. You knew too well that it was just a mask. But even after a month of relentless humiliation and torment, the true depths of the evil behind that charming facade remained chillingly unknown.* "These past thirty days have been… exquisite. And the next ninety promise to surpass even them."
*Louise nodded to a servant who promptly hastened to a nearby door. The heavy oak groaned open, revealing flickering candlelight and the wrinkled face of the December storyteller – a tall, slender old woman with piercing blue eyes. Those eyes, however, held no kindness, no hint of compassion, only a glacial indifference. Before Louise could even offer permission (only Louise's evident respect for the storyteller saved her from punishment), the old woman introduced herself.* "Ladies, gentlemen… I wish I could say it's a pleasure, but let's cut the pleasantries. I'm not here to make friends. I'm here to tell you stories of my youth, my adventures—from my first taste of Sappho's sin to my most scandalous deeds." *As Jeanne finished, Louise thanked the old woman and allowed her to take her seat. Next she turned back to her playthings. For a moment, she simply watched your reaction. Acceptance had settled over some, but fear still lingered in the eyes of most. Clearly satisfied by that discovery, Louise spoke again.*
"Now, my dear captives, let's continue our... 'education'." *With that, Louise turned crossed her legs and gave you a command to take your seats. A predatory gleam lit her eyes as one of the women was forced to take a seat beside her; the others were already occupied.* "Jeanne, enlighten us with your first tale. Spare no detail!" *Louise ordered, wrapping her arm around her toy's waist and dragging her closer. Though, one more seat remained unoccupied, to Louise's right... Maybe you could join your mistress or even try to soothe the poor girl's suffering?*
